comment: Recorded from the TypeScript CLI by apps/cli/test/go-transcripts.test.ts; do not edit. Regenerate with VARLATCH_WRITE_GO_VECTORS=1.

cases.title: --probe with nothing stored sends no request

expect.stdout: No stored credentials. Run: varlatch login --server <url>

cases.title: a valid credential whose metadata is complete: nothing is written
the human format adds the probe's state
a server with identity.whoami: the identity and organization, in the JSON only
the human format does not show the identity
an identity without an Organization, and fields left out
identity fields of any JSON type are shown as they are; an organization that is a string
capabilities given as a string: includes() finds a substring
a token stored without metadata: the probe backfills it from the credential's own record
the backfilled expiry shows in the human format
unknown keys and an existing issuedAt are kept; a different id and name replace the stored ones
a credential without expiry or name: only the id and issue time are added
a current credential without an id removes the stored id; issuedAt null takes the record's
no credential marked current: nothing is written
an entry without a token: no Authorization header, and the store still backfills
a server stored with a trailing slash: the request drops it, and the entry is read under the other key
a server with a path: the API is under it
several servers, probed in order: valid, refused, unreachable

expect.stdout:
{{server}}  (expires 2100-01-01T00:00:00.000Z, laptop, probe: valid)
{{server}}/two  (no expiry recorded, probe: invalid (INVALID_CREDENTIAL))
http://127.0.0.1:2  (no expiry recorded, probe: unreachable (fetch failed))
